findings.title: Signal has significant reference plane gap
findings.description: Net /PS1_24V has 75% reference plane coverage over 3.6mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has significant reference plane gap

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /RELAY_HB
findings.description: Net /RELAY_HB has 4 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu, In2.Cu. 4 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /RELAY_HB

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers F.Cu and In1.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
